instruction.text: C:\project\generate\microwave\video\继续建模这些微波炉 每个视频建模一个 要求生成的动画要和视频逐帧对齐 机械结构要符合，最后所有的生成结果发布在网页中 和之前的网页格式一致

instruction.source: 用户原话；助手修订记录（分别标注）
instruction.text:
注意 固定一个场景，C:\project\generate\dataset\tangyuan\scenes最终每个微波炉都要放进场景中打光，最后视觉效果要和红色微波炉一样。包括之前的solwave 重做后再发布

修订记录（助手）：依据下部腰形通风孔、长拉手、未点亮四位显示区和圆角压筋腔体固定主机型；剔除短拉手 RFS、蓝色长字符屏及阶梯压筋内胆的其他版本。保留背景中的局部画面。开门与关门来自不同剪辑，不虚构中间开门动作。降低未点亮数码管反射亮度。 另拆分三个仅一至两帧的全景插入镜头，以及 4502–4587 帧的开门腔体特写。固定视点的镜头采用 Blender 超采样渲染与等效逐帧投影，相机三维点投影已核对，输出不使用参考视频像素。 淡入淡出末端移除六帧非主机型画面；12390—12415帧采用淡入后清晰镜头的固定视点推断，避免重复按键图案造成跨机型误匹配。

provenance.dimension_basis: manufacturer family envelope; exact video variant uncertain
provenance.hidden_structure: hinge and latch internal dimensions inferred; no OEM service geometry asserted

review.frame_coverage: 8411 retained source frames at30000/1001 fps across43 principal-model segments. Both encoded videos fully decode to8411frames. Other microwave variants and food-only shots excluded; faint dissolves and partial principal views retained.
review.visual_review: All26 encoded comparison boards of animation_v003 inspected. For final animation_v004,8385 unchanged native frames were SHA256 verified and26 dissolve camera frames regenerated. All11 additional encoded boundary/closed/open frames reviewed on three final_boundary_review boards. Three1-2frame wide inserts and the4502-4587 open-cavity insert were individually repaired and reviewed.
review.revision: Nativev092: broad rounded liner, long pull, lower pill vents, unlit four-position display and recessed control panel. Distinct short-pull RFS and cyan/green-display stepped-liner variants excluded.
review.mechanics: Single left hinge. Open and closed states occur in separate edited shots; no continuous principal door opening is visible or fabricated. Hidden hinge/latch construction and the open angle are inferred.
review.geometry: Five cabinet/assembly checks pass. Structural door surfaces have no detected intersections at13 sampled angles; hinge and latch engagement excluded. This is not continuous clearance or force verification.
review.render_method: Fixed-optical-center shots use native Blender supersampled padded frusta and analytically equivalent source-frame camera projections.27 world points over the prior8417-frame camera set were checked numerically, and direct renders compared. The final26-frame correction reuses the clear incoming camera. No reference-image pixels are used in generated output.
review.alignment_limit: Not pixel-perfect. Open-liner pressing shape, tight-view perspective, glazing/reflections and focus differ. Partial views constrain only visible features; hidden depth is inferred. Editorial dissolves/title overlays are not reproduced. Incoming12390-12415 camera is inferred from clear12416 to reject cross-model keypad matches. Fade boundaries have about one-frame interpretation uncertainty. People, food and source environment are outside scope.
review.scene: Frozen Tangyuan kitchen with shared external lighting; estimated internal lamp only in open states.
